title: Traceback
description: A COMPLETE, ORDERED chain from a consequence back to the decision that caused it. Complete matters: a chain missing its middle reads as a coincidence, and the participant is right to distrust it. R4 B2.

chain.description: Ordered by when it happened, never by how it was stored.

narrative.description: ★ Plain language, readable by a participant and not only by a developer. It names the SCENE, never an identifier.
